mapper.insert: INSERT INTO presale_ai_call ( version_id, batch_no, platform_code, platform_code_snapshot, platform_name_snapshot, model_id_snapshot, model_name_snapshot, prompt_template_id, competitor_name, stage, parent_call_id, request_prompt_content, query_contract_version, search_evidence_json, call_status, retry_count, raw_response, payload_purged_at, failure_reason, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, duration_ms ) SELECT #{row.versionId}, #{row.batchNo}, #{row.platformCode}, #{row.platformCodeSnapshot}, #{row.platformNameSnapshot}, #{row.modelIdSnapshot}, #{row.modelNameSnapshot}, #{row.promptTemplateId}, #{row.competitorName}, #{row.stage}, #{row.parentCallId}, #{row.requestPromptContent}, #{row.queryContractVersion}, #{row.searchEvidenceJson}, #{row.callStatus}, #{row.retryCount}, #{row.rawResponse}, #{row.payloadPurgedAt}, #{row.failureReason}, #{row.promptTokens}, #{row.completionTokens}, #{row.durationMs} FROM presale_report_version v WHERE v.id = #{row.versionId} AND v.generation_status = 'RUNNING' AND v.generation_attempt = #{generationAttempt}
